purpose: Classify each of the 34 existing trusted (frozen golden-manifest) present-opportunities as file-local or cross-module under the LLM-PRV-001, LLM-EVL-001, and LLM-EVL-002 evidence contracts named in action item 3. This is retrospective engineering classification of already-frozen v1.9 golden ground truth; it labels no new opportunity, relabels no existing ground truth, and reruns no detector.

derived_contracts_for_remaining_rules._note: Action item 3 enumerated explicit file-local/cross-module contracts only for LLM-PRV-001, LLM-EVL-001, and LLM-EVL-002 (24 of the 34 rows). The 34 trusted present-opportunities span all 7 rules that produced a present label in the v1.9 golden set. For the remaining 4 rules (LLM-AGY-001, LLM-VAL-001, LLM-IOH-001, LLM-DAT-001; 10 of the 34 rows) this document applies the equivalent local/resolved-inter-procedural distinction already frozen in docs/packs/free-llm-v1-rule-contract.md for that rule, and flags each such row for owner confirmation that this extension is in scope.

methodology_and_limitations: Every one of the 34 frozen evidence_scope entries in the golden opportunity manifest pins a single file+line anchor (start_line == end_line in all 34 cases). Every one of the three named contracts, and the derived contracts for the remaining four rules, requires confirming a second local component (a producer/judge pair, an iteration+aggregation+emission chain, or an invocation+result pair) that the frozen single-point anchor does not itself locate.

Whole-file source bytes for the golden cohort are not committed to this repository. Per protocol.md section 5 step 8 and the calibration README, the source-evidence index retains only a digest (source_evidence_index_sha256) in public artifacts; the whole-file bytes and Git blob/tree proofs live in restricted internal evidence outside this working tree.

The only source-level text committed for this cycle is calibration/llm/results/v1.9-golden-execution-evidence.json and its -v2 counterpart, which record just 3 detector findings total across the entire golden cohort -- all 3 are LLM-PRV-001 false positives adjudicated against no frozen opportunity (see the correction ledger). None of the 34 present-labeled opportunities has an associated detector finding or narrative description in any committed v1.9 artifact; this is consistent with, and is the direct cause of, the recorded zero finding recall.

One golden repository's execution receipt (Ankitha-GS/rag-qa) additionally records that the origin no longer resolves on GitHub as of the most recent re-execution, which is independent confirmation that live external re-inspection of golden source is not a reliable or reproducible substitute for the missing committed evidence for this cycle.

Because no committed artifact differentiates the required second local component per opportunity, every one of the 34 rows is genuinely ambiguous under this document's own definition of file-local. Per the governing instruction for this action item, genuine ambiguity is classified cross-module and flagged for owner review rather than guessed as file-local.

This is a structural, not a performance, conclusion: it says the frozen v1.9 golden evidence as committed cannot support a file-local determination for any of the 34 items, not that the underlying repository code is actually cross-module in every case.
